name: invasions

attributes.attribute: a term for the mythic history of Ireland told in the Book of Invasions
also called Lebor Gabála Érenn, it tells of six invasions from the flood to the final settlers

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Invasions is a term for the mythic history of Ireland. The full title is the Book of Invasions, or Lebor Gabála Érenn. Under that name the work tells of six invasions of Ireland from the biblical flood to the final settlers. The book was compiled in the 12th century in several versions. Older parts date to much earlier. Successive peoples reached the island. Each held it until the next arrival.
objective: Document the mythic term invasions and its source text.
key_results: Define invasions as the term for Ireland's mythic history.
Name the Book of Invasions as the source text.
Note the six invasions and the 12th-century compilation.
